sources.SMALL_MARGINAL_SHARE: Agriculture Census commentary (retrieved): small & marginal holdings are ~86% of Indian operational holdings; marginal = <1 ha, small = 1-2 ha (PIB categorisation). Maharashtra-specific split was NOT verified - see ASSUMPTION_PRIORS.
sources.SC_ST_SHARE: Wikipedia / Census 2011 (retrieved): SC ~16.6% and ST ~8.6% of India's population. Maharashtra-specific SC/ST shares were NOT verified - the defaults below are therefore CONFIGURABLE PRIORS, not official state figures.

assumptions: Social-category, land-holding, gender and employment marginals are plausible priors for a rural applicant pool, not verified Maharashtra statistics. Edit PRIORS before quoting any distributional claim.

Asset-transfer schemes (2-milch unit, goat/sheep unit, chicks, pullets) are treated as ACQUISITION schemes: an applicant who already owns many animals of that species is down-ranked, and above OWN_CAP is treated as not a target beneficiary. The GRs do not state such a cap.

OBC is treated as eligible for the state-level (general) 2-milch scheme at 50%, and as a 'backward class' for the poultry schemes, but NOT for the district-level SC/TSP/OTSP 2-milch and goat/sheep components. Verify against the current GR / district office.
Breed is sampled independently of district by default. Breed-tract geography (e.g. which division a breed is concentrated in) was NOT verified here, so USE_REGION_TILT defaults to False.
caveat: Rupee figures come from GRs of 2021-2023 as republished by the Maharashtra Animal Husbandry Department. Confirm on ah.mahabms.com or with the district Animal Husbandry office before any real application.
